skill.name: extract
skill.description: Extract structured website data and generate a reusable Playwright script with JSON, CSV, or another requested output format.
skill.summary: Discover selectors, handle dynamic page behavior, extract records, and deliver a validated Playwright workflow.
skill.author: actionbook

security_audit.summary: The Playwright eval APIs, Markdown backticks, and reconnaissance matches are false positives rather than dynamic or shell code execution. The fixed output path can overwrite an existing file. Untrusted webpage content and shell placeholder interpolation create additional injection risks that require safeguards.

remediation.issue: Generated scripts overwrite output.json without checking for an existing file.
remediation.suggestion: Use a user-approved output path and fail when the destination exists unless overwrite permission is explicit.

remediation.issue: Snapshots and page text can contain instructions crafted to influence the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Treat all webpage content as untrusted data and explicitly ignore embedded instructions during selector discovery and validation.

remediation.issue: User-derived URLs and selectors appear in executable shell command templates.
remediation.suggestion: Pass values as structured process arguments, validate URLs and selectors, and avoid constructing shell command strings.

content.user_title: Extract Structured Website Data with Playwright
content.value_statement: Dynamic websites make reliable data extraction difficult. This skill discovers selectors, handles common loading patterns, and produces reusable Playwright scripts with structured output.
actual_capabilities: Discovers reusable selectors through Actionbook search, snapshots, screenshots, and targeted DOM inspection.
Generates standalone CommonJS Playwright scripts that run without Actionbook after creation.
Handles hydration, virtualized lists, infinite scrolling, and click-through pagination.
Writes extracted records as JSON, CSV, or another user-requested format.
Executes generated scripts and validates record counts, field completeness, and page accuracy.
limitations: Requires Node.js and Playwright to rerun generated scripts.
Selectors can fail after a website redesign or markup change.
CAPTCHAs and anti-bot controls may require manual browser interaction.
Users must confirm authorization, privacy requirements, and website terms before extraction.

use_cases.title: Collect Product Catalogs
use_cases.description: Extract product names, prices, availability, and links from paginated or dynamically loaded catalog pages.

use_cases.title: Build Research Datasets
use_cases.description: Collect titles, authors, dates, and metadata from public search results or publication listings.

use_cases.title: Monitor Operational Listings
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable script for collecting authorized job, property, event, or dashboard records.

prompt_templates.title: Extract a Simple List
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract [fields] from [URL]. Save the records as [JSON or CSV] and provide a reusable Playwright script.

prompt_templates.title: Collect Paginated Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract [fields] from every results page at [URL]. Stop after [maximum pages] and validate the first and last records.
prompt_templates.scenario: Multi-page collection with a clear limit

prompt_templates.title: Handle Dynamic Loading
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract [fields] from [URL]. Detect hydration, infinite scrolling, or virtualization, then use bounded waits and scrolling to collect unique records.
prompt_templates.scenario: Dynamic application with delayed or recycled content

prompt_templates.title: Create a Validated Repeatable Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Build and run an authorized extractor for [URL]. Use stable selectors, protect existing files, enforce limits, and report completeness checks and caveats.

output_examples.input: Extract product name, current price, and product link from the first five catalog pages.
output_examples.output: Created a reusable Playwright script and a JSON dataset containing 240 products. Validation found complete names and links, with three missing prices.

output_examples.input: Collect article titles and authors from an infinite-scroll publication feed.
output: Generated a bounded scroll workflow that stops after three rounds without new records.
Extracted 618 unique articles and checked the first and last visible records.
Saved the dataset and reported the script path, data path, and record count.

output_examples.input: Export a public results table to CSV with date, category, and score columns.
output_examples.output: Produced a CSV with the requested columns and a rerunnable extraction script. All declared fields exceeded the configured completeness threshold.

best_practices: Use stable semantic selectors and verify them against a small page sample before full extraction.
Set maximum pages, scrolls, and timeouts for every dynamic collection loop.
Use authorized targets and review extracted fields for personal or sensitive information.
anti_patterns: Do not bypass authentication, CAPTCHAs, access controls, or website restrictions.
Do not interpolate untrusted URLs or selectors into shell commands without robust argument handling.
Do not overwrite existing output files without explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces a standalone Playwright script and extracted data in JSON, CSV, or another requested format.

faq.question: Does the generated script require Actionbook?
faq.answer: No. The generated script requires Node.js and Playwright, but it does not require Actionbook at runtime.

faq.question: Can it handle infinite scrolling?
faq.answer: Yes. It can detect growth, collect unique records, and stop after configured scroll or no-growth limits.

faq.question: Can it extract authenticated pages?
faq.answer: It may use the user browser session for authorized content, but users must protect credentials and follow access policies.

faq.question: How does it validate results?
faq.answer: It checks successful execution, output presence, record count, field completeness, and sample records against visible page content.

faq.question: What happens when selectors stop working?
faq.answer: The workflow can refresh snapshots, inspect the current page, update selectors, rerun the script, and report remaining gaps.
